spanish: O alma que tocare en toda cosa impura, o en cadáver de bestia viva impura, o en cadáver de animal impuro, o en cadáver de reptil impuro, y se ocultare desde él, y él impuro, y culpado.

findings.issue: חַיָּה is one common noun (lemma 2416 c). «bestia viva» splits it so «viva» can be read as an extra alive-state the noun morphology does not mark.
שֶׁרֶץ is a common noun for a swarming or creeping creature. «reptil» narrows that to the reptile class.
Niphal sequential perfect 3ms: it is hidden. «se ocultare» takes feminine «alma» as the one who hides herself.
The suffix is 1st person common plural (from us). «él» is 3rd person masculine singular.
Qal sequential perfect 3ms (he becomes guilty) is a bare passive participle, not a qal finite verb.

notes: Packet morph on מִמֶּנּוּ is Sp1cp; the Spanish suffix is 3ms.
